The following fictional handbook describes Cedar Town Library. The library is open on Monday from 09:00 to 17:00, with no lunch closure. These Monday times remain the same in every season. The question at the end concerns only this schedule.

Tuesday through Friday follow the same public opening schedule. On Saturday the building opens at 10:00 and closes at 14:00. The library is closed on Sunday. A holiday notice may change a future date, but this handbook describes an ordinary Monday without any holiday.

The entrance desk gives visitors a printed map. Fiction, history, science and local studies each have their own shelf labels. Large print books stand beside the reading room. Signs use short words and clear arrows so that a first-time visitor can find a section without asking for directions.

The reading room has several tables near the windows. Visitors may read quietly, take handwritten notes, or use their own laptop. A small clock above the door displays the same local time as the entrance desk. Staff announce closing time ten minutes before the building closes.

Borrowers may check out ordinary books for three weeks. A book can be renewed if another reader has not requested it. Reference books remain inside the building because they are often needed by several people on the same day. Returned books go into a clearly marked box by the entrance.

The catalogue contains a title, author, subject and shelf location for each item. A record marked available means the item should be on its shelf or on a nearby return cart. A record marked checked out means that a reader has borrowed the item. Neither status changes the public opening hours.

The children reading corner contains picture books, simple puzzles and low tables. Families keep the walkway clear for visitors using wheelchairs or strollers. A notice board lists optional storytelling sessions. Those sessions take place during opening hours and do not extend the Monday closing time.

A meeting room can be reserved for community groups. Reservations include time for setting up chairs and putting them away again. The room must be empty before the building closes. The fictional handbook lists no evening opening, private access arrangement or additional Monday session.

Staff check the weather notice each morning and place a mat beside the entrance when it rains. The ordinary timetable remains the one stated at the beginning of this handbook. The handbook does not describe any emergency, closure, power cut or exception for the Monday in the question.
